result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major content/localization bug and one minor truncation issue.

issues.description: The section title 'home_feed.popular_title' is displaying a raw localization key instead of the actual translated text. This indicates a missing or broken i18n/localization string.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' has a corresponding translation value in all supported languages and that the localization system is correctly loading the strings at runtime.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is being truncated and cut off at the edge of the screen, making it unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis text overflow handling or adjust the card width/text wrapping so the full restaurant name is visible or clearly truncated with '...' to indicate more text exists.
